A request on the real native TLS listener charges the PostgreSQL device-session source budget before verifying the bearer. With the 19 browser actors, a missing bearer refusal inherently changes a non-exempt table.
The shared dispatch charges the native source budget before checking a device credential. A direct TLS denial with a browser-only actor would change a non-exempt table.
